extract_point_clouds_from_scannet: run the script to extract aligned point clouds from ScanNet sens files into npz format
extract_point_clouds_with_color: run the script to extract RGB-colored point clouds from depth and color image pairs
extract_point_clouds_to_npz: run the script to extract point clouds and save them as npz files in the output folder
extract_point_clouds_skip_existing: run the script to extract point clouds while skipping frames that already have npz output files
extract_point_clouds_with_camera_pose: run the script to extract point clouds transformed to world coordinates using camera pose files
